g.text: ISA-JSON model (the parts Metatrack and MARS use)
ISA-JSON 1.0 schemas · every object has an @id, references point to it
Processes link these through inputs/outputs; MARS follows the chain backwards from each file.
: all field values are Characteristics or Comments, not fixed columns.
MARS reads Characteristic values as objects (OntologyAnnotation), not plain strings.
